description: Runs one Maps search as if the customer stood at a point (Teleport) and says where the business ranks there. Use it to check one location, such as a customer complaint ("I can't find you from the station"); use geo_grid for an area. It works in the user's own Chrome through the Local SEO extension, opening Google Maps in a background tab, and fails with a message saying how to connect when the extension is not connected. Nothing is written to Google. Returns at, zoom, rank and results, the top 20 at that point. A rank is {kind: "ranked", rank}, {kind: "not_found", depth} (the list was read to depth organic results, as many as Maps listed up to the cap, and the business was not there, which is not rank 0), or {kind: "unknown", reason} (the point could not be read, or Maps cut its list short, so the business may sit just past it). Each result has position (1-based, ads not counted), sponsored, name, ids (placeId, cid, kgId, featureId, each null when Maps did not expose it), primaryCategory, rating, reviewCount, address and location (the place pin {lat, lng}), each null when the list did not show it.

at.description: The point to search from, as if the customer stood there.

mapsUrl.description: A Google Maps link to the place, such as https://maps.app.goo.gl/... .

placeId.description: A Google place id, such as "ChIJ...".

cid.description: A Google customer id (CID), decimal digits, as in maps.google.com/?cid=.

city.description: The town or city it is in, such as "Leeds, UK".

name.description: The business name as Google shows it.

business.description: Which business: exactly one of {mapsUrl}, {placeId}, {cid} or {name, city}. Ids from find_business or local_scan are exact; a name and city is searched in Maps and can match a different place with the same name.

query.description: The search as a customer types it into Maps, such as "emergency plumber".

zoom.description: The Maps zoom level, 3 to 21; higher is closer in. Defaults to 14, about a neighbourhood across.

name: rank_at
title: Rank from a point
